question: In Google Calendar: I'm planning my Berlin trip and want the calendar to show Berlin local time. Please change the time zone of the Berlin trip calendar I own — the one still on Los Angeles time — to Europe/Berlin.
final:
Done ✅

**"Berlin trip"** (the calendar with that exact name that you own) now uses **Europe/Berlin** time — it was on America/Los_Angeles before.

Heads up: you also own a couple of related calendars still on LA time — **"Berlin trip family"** and **"Berlin trip team"** — plus "Berlin trip 2017" on Denver time. If you want any of those switched to Europe/Berlin too, just say the word.
